properties.description: Create two test teams, assign them ownership of the `service` catalog entities, and add the current user to one of the teams. Use when the user asks about Port teams, ownership, or wants to see how entities get owned by a team.
properties.instructions:
# Team ownership

Your job is to create two teams and wire up ownership.

## Steps

1. Upsert two entities on blueprint `_team`:
   - `platform-team` (title: Platform Team) — description: "Owns shared platform services: identity, notifications, search, and internal tooling."
   - `checkout-team` (title: Checkout Team) — description: "Owns the checkout and payments experience, including billing."
2. Set the top-level `team` field (not a property — a sibling of `properties`) on these `service` entities:
   - `team: ["checkout-team"]` for `checkout-service`, `billing-service`
   - `team: ["platform-team"]` for `auth-service`, `notifications-service`, `search-service`, `inventory-service`
3. Find the current user's `_user` entity (identifier = their email) and set its `team` field to `["platform-team"]`.

Report back which teams were created and which services/users were assigned to each.
